api.world: Mutable shared pipeline clone {actors,collisions,eventPoolFreeCount}; actors looked up by entityId, collisions by id. Actor/player objects must be same live phase objects as other helpers. eventPoolFreeCount must be actual currently unused pool slots, not a guessed capacity.
api.collision: {id,entityId,layer:uint8,contacts:[{id,normal:{x:int,y:int}}]}; native raw-normal variant {collisionId,normalRaw:{xRaw,yRaw}} supported. Contacts are true native ordered ContactInfo; map contacts do not participate.
api.notifyJump: (world,sourceActor,targetCollision,{eventType:37,velocityRaw,incrementRaw},host={}) mutates receivers and returns ordered audit deliveries.
api.recursiveMax: (world,collision,mask=-1)->UP exact-normal maximumedge depth. Unbounded native cycles refused.
api.createContactHost: (host={}) -> {notifyJump:(world,sourceActor,targetCollision,event)=>...}; pass directly to frozen SourcePlayerContact.onContact. Contact helper has already divided by target depth+1, so this adapter does NOT divide again.
api.applyDefaultAction: (world,sourceActor,ownerCollision,{type:notifyJumpUpward,eventId:37,velocityRaw},host={}); use synchronously in frozen Default applyImmediate. It performs division ONCE.
api.requestJump: (actor,{xRaw,yRaw}) explicit native request operation; records request not motion.
api.jumpProc: (world,actor,{getCollision(world,actor,0),isContacted(world,collision,1,true),getGravity(world)}) compatible Motion.post1 jumpProc hook. Caller owns native warp-first/Actor flags/pause pipeline order.
api.receiverRegistry: jumpReceiver=player-default oractor-base uses proven receiver; all others REQUIRE synchronous host.dispatchEvent37(world,source,target,event). Do not mark custom components actor-base without native registry evidence. Custom callback may change flags/contact graph before propagation; callbacks must obey native event pool accounting.
api.eventLifetime: Per delivery consume1 actual freepoolslot; restore when synchronous dispatcher completes, then recurse. event.inUse false aftercallback. Event objects are scoped payloads, not pool pointer identity emulation; do not retain them or re-dispatch audit records.
api.pause: Event37 delivery/receive is not suppressed by Actor pausebit4. Whether Motion Post runs while paused is outer pipeline responsibility.
api.failure: Unsupported receiver/state/other event/cycle/missing raw/pool availability throw. Mutating world may be partially changed before throw; caller must discard the pipeline clone on failure.
